all or nothing.\n\n    The balance rule is judged over the whole file's net effect per account, so a withdrawal listed\n    before its funding deposit is accepted when the final balance is not below zero.\n    \"\"\"\n    checked = _checked_transactions(db, args[0])\n    check_no_negative(db, [Insert(account=account, amount=cents) for _, _, account, _, cents, _ in checked])\n    run_all([(_insert_txn(db, row), _remove(db.transactions.delete, row[0])) for row in checked])\n    return [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"transactions\", str(len(checked))]]\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {\n    (\"load\", \"accounts\"): Command(load_accounts, 1, 1),\n    (\"load\", \"categories\"): Command(load_categories, 1, 1),\n    (\"load\", \"transactions\"): Command(load_transactions, 1, 1),\n}","originalFile":"\"\"\"``ledger load`` commands: ``accounts`` and ``categories`` are all-or-nothing bulk loads.\n\nEvery row of the file is checked before the first write: the key, the text, the key's repetition\nwithin the file, and the key's presence in the store. The rows are then inserted through\n``ledger_core.atomic.run_all``, so a failing insert removes the rows already stored.\n\n``transactions`` keeps each file ``txn_id`` and checks the foreign keys, date, amount, memo, repeats,\nand the balance rule over the whole file before its first write.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom collections.abc import Callable, Iterable\n\nfrom cli.registry import Command\nfrom ledger_core.atomic import run_all\nfrom ledger_core.balances import Insert, check_no_negative\nfrom ledger_core.csvio import read_rows\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Operational, Rejected\nfrom ledger_core.money import parse_amount\nfrom ledger_core.transactions import parse_txn_id\nfrom ledger_core.validation import validate_code, validate_date, validate_memo, validate_name\n\nACCOUNT_HEADER = (\"account\", \"name\")\nCATEGORY_HEADER = (\"category\", \"description\")\nTRANSACTION_HEADER = (\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\")\n\n\ndef _checked_rows(\n    path: str,\n    header: tuple[str, str],\n    validate_key: Callable[[str], str],\n    stored: Iterable[str],\n) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"Validate every row of ``path`` before any write; return ``(key, text)`` pairs in file order.\"\"\"\n    already_stored = set(stored)\n    seen: set[str] = set()\n    checked: list[tuple[str, str]] = []\n    for line, (key_text, text) in read_rows(path, header):\n        try:\n            key = validate_key(key_text)\n            validate_name(text)\n        except Rejected as exc:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {line}: {exc}\") from exc\n        if key in seen:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {line}: code {key} repeats within the file\")\n        if key in already_stored:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {line}: code {key} is already stored\")\n        seen.add(key)\n        checked.append((key, text))\n    return checked\n\n\ndef _load(\n    path: str,\n    header: tuple[str, str],\n    table: str,\n    validate_key: Callable[[str], str],\n    stored: Iterable[str],\n    create: Callable[[str, str], object],\n    remove: Callable[[str], object],\n) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Check the whole file, insert every row as one unit, and report the loaded count.\"\"\"\n    checked = _checked_rows(path, header, validate_key, stored)\n    run_all([(_insert(create, key, text), _remove(remove, key)) for key, text in checked])\n    return [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [table, str(len(checked))]]\n\n\ndef _insert(create: Callable[[str, str], object], key: str, text: str) -> Callable[[], object]:\n    return lambda: create(key, text)\n\n\ndef _remove(remove: Callable[[str], object], key: str) -> Callable[[], object]:\n    return lambda: remove(key)\n\n\ndef load_accounts(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Load ``account,name`` rows from ``args[0]``; nothing is stored unless every row is valid.\"\"\"\n    return _load(\n        args[0],\n        ACCOUNT_HEADER,\n        \"accounts\",\n        validate_code,\n        (row.account for row in db.accounts.list()),\n        lambda key, name: db.accounts.create(account=key, name=name),\n        lambda key: db.accounts.delete(account=key),\n    )\n\n\ndef load_categories(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Load ``category,description`` rows from ``args[0]``; nothing is stored unless every row is valid.\"\"\"\n    return _load(\n        args[0],\n        CATEGORY_HEADER,\n        \"categories\",\n        validate_code,\n        (row.category for row in db.categories.list()),\n        lambda key, text: db.categories.create(category=key, description=text),\n        lambda key: db.categories.delete(category=key),\n    )\n\n\ndef _transactions_placeholder(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    read_rows(args[0], TRANSACTION_HEADER)\n    raise Operational(\"loading transactions is not implemented yet\")\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {\n    (\"load\", \"accounts\"): Command(load_accounts, 1, 1),\n    (\"load\", \"categories\"): Command(load_categories, 1, 1),\n    (\"load\", \"transactions\"): Command(_transactions_placeholder, 1, 1),\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":98,"oldLines":13,"newStart":98,"newLines":58,"lines":["     )"," "," ","-def _transactions_placeholder(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:","-    read_rows(args[0], TRANSACTION_HEADER)","-    raise Operational(\"loading transactions is not implemented yet\")","+TxnRow = tuple[int, str, str, str, int, str]"," "," ","+def _checked_transactions(db, path: str) -> list[TxnRow]:","+    \"\"\"Validate every row of ``path`` before any write; {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01M82HhX6gkheAZLbhqZFwqE","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/cli/commands/load.py has been updated successfully. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"3d6c23d9-bd7a-4743-8d5d-6d8e6078828d","uuid":"0aa5080b-1d9d-40e7-970c-332dadc5df74","timestamp":"2026-10-27T14:54:26.704Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/cli/commands/load.py","oldString":"def load_transactions(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Load ``txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`` rows from ``args[0]``; all or nothing.\n\n    The balance rule is judged over the whole file's net effect per account, so a withdrawal listed\n    before its funding deposit is accepted when the final balance is not below zero.\n    \"\"\"\n    checked = _checked_transactions(db, args[0])\n    check_no_negative(db, [Insert(account=account, amount=cents) for _, _, account, _, cents, _ in checked])\n    run_all([(_insert_txn(db, row), _remove(db.transactions.delete, row[0])) for row in checked])","newString":"def _delete_txn(db, txn_id: int) -> Callable[[], object]:\n    return lambda: db.transactions.delete(txn_id=txn_id)\n\n\ndef load_transactions(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Load ``txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`` rows from ``args[0]``; all or nothing.\n\n    The balance rule is judged over the whole file's net effect per account, so a withdrawal listed\n    before its funding deposit is accepted when the final balance is not below zero.\n    \"\"\"\n    checked = _checked_transactions(db, args[0])\n    check_no_negative(db, [Insert(account=account, amount=cents) for _, _, account, _, cents, _ in checked])\n    run_all([(_insert_txn(db, row), _delete_txn(db, row[0])) for row in checked])","originalFile":"\"\"\"``ledger load`` commands: ``accounts`` and ``categories`` are all-or-nothing bulk loads.\n\nEvery row of the file is checked before the first write: the key, the text, the key's repetition\nwithin the file, and the key's presence in the store. The rows are then inserted through\n``ledger_core.atomic.run_all``, so a failing insert removes the rows already stored.\n\n``transactions`` keeps each file ``txn_id`` and checks the foreign keys, date, amount, memo, repeats,\nand the balance rule over the whole file before its first write.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom collections.abc import Callable, Iterable\n\nfrom cli.registry import Command\nfrom ledger_core.atomic import run_all\nfrom ledger_core.balances import Insert, check_no_negative\nfrom ledger_core.csvio import read_rows\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Operational, Rejected\nfrom ledger_core.money import parse_amount\nfrom ledger_core.transactions import parse_txn_id\nfrom ledger_core.validation import validate_code, validate_date, validate_memo, validate_name\n\nACCOUNT_HEADER = (\"account\", \"name\")\nCATEGORY_HEADER = (\"category\", \"description\")\nTRANSACTION_HEADER = (\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\")\n\n\ndef _checked_rows(\n    path: str,\n    header: tuple[str, str],\n    validate_key: Callable[[str], str],\n    stored: Iterable[str],\n) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"Validate every row of ``path`` before any write; return ``(key, text)`` pairs in file order.\"\"\"\n    already_stored = set(stored)\n    seen: set[str] = set()\n    checked: list[tuple[str, str]] = []\n    for line, (key_text, text) in read_rows(path, header):\n        try:\n            key = validate_key(key_text)\n            validate_name(text)\n        except Rejected as exc:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {line}: {exc}\") from exc\n        if key in seen:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {line}: code {key} repeats within the file\")\n        if key in already_stored:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {line}: code {key} is already stored\")\n        seen.add(key)\n        checked.append((key, text))\n    return checked\n\n\ndef _load(\n    path: str,\n    header: tuple[str, str],\n    table: str,\n    validate_key: Callable[[str], str],\n    stored: Iterable[str],\n    create: Callable[[str, str], object],\n    remove: Callable[[str], object],\n) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Check the whole file, insert every row as one unit, and report the loaded count.\"\"\"\n    checked = _checked_rows(path, header, validate_key, stored)\n    run_all([(_insert(create, key, text), _remove(remove, key)) for key, text in checked])\n    return [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [table, str(len(checked))]]\n\n\ndef _insert(create: Callable[[str, str], object], key: str, text: str) -> Callable[[], object]:\n    return lambda: create(key, text)\n\n\ndef _remove(remove: Callable[[str], object], key: str) -> Callable[[], object]:\n    return lambda: remove(key)\n\n\ndef load_accounts(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Load ``account,name`` rows from ``args[0]``; nothing is stored unless every row is valid.\"\"\"\n    return _load(\n        args[0],\n        ACCOUNT_HEADER,\n        \"accounts\",\n        validate_code,\n        (row.account for row in db.accounts.list()),\n        lambda key, name: db.accounts.create(account=key, name=name),\n        lambda key: db.accounts.delete(account=key),\n    )\n\n\ndef load_categories(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Load ``category,description`` rows from ``args[0]``; nothing is stored unless every row is valid.\"\"\"\n    return _load(\n        args[0],\n        CATEGORY_HEADER,\n        \"categories\",\n        validate_code,\n        (row.category for row in db.categories.list()),\n        lambda key, text: db.categories.create(category=key, description=text),\n        lambda key: db.categories.delete(category=key),\n    )\n\n\nTxnRow = tuple[int, str, str, str, int, str]\n\n\ndef _checked_transactions(db, path: str) -> list[TxnRow]:\n    \"\"\"Validate every row of ``path`` before any write; return ``(txn_id, date, account, category, cents, memo)``.\"\"\"\n    stored_ids = {txn.txn_id for txn in db.transactions.list()}\n    accounts = {row.account for row in db.accounts.list()}\n    categories = {row.category for row in db.categories.list()}\n    seen: set[int] = set()\n    checked: list[TxnRow] = []\n    for line, (id_text, day, account, category, amount_text, memo) in read_rows(path, TRANSACTION_HEADER):\n        try:\n            txn_id = parse_txn_id(id_text)\n            validate_date(day)\n            cents = parse_amount(amount_text)\n            validate_memo(memo)\n        except Rejected as exc:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {line}: {exc}\") from exc\n        if account not in accounts:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {line}: account {account} does not exist\")\n        if category not in categories:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {line}: category {category} does not exist\")\n        if txn_id in seen:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {line}: transaction {txn_id} repeats within the file\")\n        if txn_id in stored_ids:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {line}: transaction {txn_id} is already stored\")\n        seen.add(txn_id)\n        checked.append((txn_id, day, account, category, cents, memo))\n    return checked\n\n\ndef _insert_txn(db, row: TxnRow) -> Callable[[], object]:\n    txn_id, day, account, category, cents, memo = row\n    return lambda: db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=txn_id, date=day, account=account, category=category, amount=cents, memo=memo\n    )\n\n\ndef load_transactions(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Load ``txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`` rows from ``args[0]``; all or nothing.\n\n    The balance rule is judged over the whole file's net effect per account, so a withdrawal listed\n    before its funding deposit is accepted when the final balance is not below zero.\n    \"\"\"\n    checked = _checked_transactions(db, args[0])\n    check_no_negative(db, [Insert(account=account, amount=cents) for _, _, account, _, cents, _ in checked])\n    run_all([(_insert_txn(db, row), _remove(db.transactions.delete, row[0])) for row in checked])\n    return [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"transactions\", str(len(checked))]]\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {\n    (\"load\", \"accounts\"): Command(load_accounts, 1, 1),\n    (\"load\", \"categories\"): Command(load_categories, 1, 1),\n    (\"load\", \"transactions\"): Command(load_transactions, 1, 1),\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":136,"oldLines":6,"newStart":136,"newLines":10,"lines":["     )"," "," ","+def _delete_txn(db, txn_id: int) -> Callable[[], object]:","+    return lambda: db.transactions.delete(txn_id=txn_id)","+","+"," def load_transactions(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:","     \"\"\"Load ``txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`` rows from ``args[0]``; all or nothing."," "]},{"oldStart":144,"oldLines":7,"newStart":148,"newLines":7,"lines":["     \"\"\"","     checked = _checked_transactions(db, args[0])","     check_no_negative(db, [Insert(account=account, amount=cents) for _, _, account, _, cents, _ in checked])","-    run_all([(_insert_txn(db, row), _remove(db.transactions.delete, row[0])) for row in checked])","+    run_all([(_insert_txn(db, row), _delete_txn(db, row[0])) for row in checked])","     return [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"transactions\", str(len(checked))]]"," "," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01M82HhX6gkheAZLbhqZFwqE","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgSw7jAfjzDNeepDSM8mN","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Ma7f4dXJy71pJ8jtgRZYEy","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/tests/test_load_transactions.py","content":"\"\"\"``ledger load transactions``: all-or-nothing loads with validation and the balance rule checked first.\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence import PersistenceError\nfrom persistence import db as persistence_db\n\nHEADER = [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\nACCT = \"ZTA1\"\nCAT = \"ZTC1\"\n\n\ndef _write(path, rows, header=HEADER) -> str:\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as fh:\n        writer = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        writer.writerow(header)\n        writer.writerows(rows)\n    return str(path)\n\n\ndef _rows(out: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ndef _cents(text: str) -> int:\n    return int(Decimal(text) * 100)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef seeded(ledger_store, store_open):\n    \"\"\"Create the account and category the rows reference, and return the store path.\"\"\"\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        db.accounts.create(account=ACCT, name=\"Txn Load Account\")\n        db.categories.create(category=CAT, description=\"Txn Load Category\")\n    return ledger_store\n\n\ndef _stored(store_open, path) -> dict[int, tuple]:\n    with store_open(path) as db:\n        return {\n            row.txn_id: (row.date, row.account, row.category, row.amount, row.memo)\n            for row in db.transactions.list()\n        }\n\n\n# ── success ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_load_reports_count_and_keeps_file_txn_ids(seeded, store_open, tmp_path):\n    rows = [\n        [\"920000001\", \"2026-01-02\", ACCT, CAT, \"100.50\", \"deposit\"],\n        [\"920000002\", \"2026-01-03\", ACCT, CAT, \"-20.25\", \"withdrawal\"],\n        [\"920000003\", \"2026-01-04\", ACCT, CAT, \"7\", \"\"],\n    ]\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"txns.csv\", rows)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"transactions\", \"3\"]]\n    stored = _stored(store_open, seeded)\n    for txn_id, day, account, category, amount, memo in rows:\n        assert stored[int(txn_id)] == (day, account, category, _cents(amount), memo)\n\n\ndef test_load_header_only_loads_zero_rows(seeded, tmp_path):\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"txns.csv\", [])\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"transactions\", \"0\"]]\n\n\ndef test_load_accepts_memo_of_exactly_sixty_characters(seeded, store_open, tmp_path):\n    memo = \"m\" * 60\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"txns.csv\", [[\"920000010\", \"2026-01-05\", ACCT, CAT, \"1.00\", memo]])\n    code, _, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _stored(store_open, seeded)[920000010][4] == memo\n\n\ndef test_load_accepts_amount_with_one_decimal_and_negative_sign(seeded, store_open, tmp_path):\n    path = _write(\n        tmp_path / \"txns.csv\",\n        [[\"920000011\", \"2026-01-05\", ACCT, CAT, load transactions``: all-or-nothing loads with validation and the balance rule checked first.\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence import PersistenceError\nfrom persistence import db as persistence_db\n\nHEADER = [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\nACCT = \"ZTA1\"\nCAT = \"ZTC1\"\n\n\ndef _write(path, rows, header=HEADER) -> str:\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as fh:\n        writer = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        writer.writerow(header)\n        writer.writerows(rows)\n    return str(path)\n\n\ndef _rows(out: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ndef _cents(text: str) -> int:\n    return int(Decimal(text) * 100)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef seeded(ledger_store, store_open):\n    \"\"\"Create the account and category the rows reference, and return the store path.\"\"\"\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        db.accounts.create(account=ACCT, name=\"Txn Load Account\")\n        db.categories.create(category=CAT, description=\"Txn Load Category\")\n    return ledger_store\n\n\ndef _stored(store_open, path) -> dict[int, tuple]:\n    with store_open(path) as db:\n        return {\n            row.txn_id: (row.date, row.account, row.category, row.amount, row.memo)\n            for row in db.transactions.list()\n        }\n\n\n# ── success ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_load_reports_count_and_keeps_file_txn_ids(seeded, store_open, tmp_path):\n    rows = [\n        [\"920000001\", \"2026-01-02\", ACCT, CAT, \"100.50\", \"deposit\"],\n        [\"920000002\", \"2026-01-03\", ACCT, CAT, \"-20.25\", \"withdrawal\"],\n        [\"920000003\", \"2026-01-04\", ACCT, CAT, \"7\", \"\"],\n    ]\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"txns.csv\", rows)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"transactions\", \"3\"]]\n    stored = _stored(store_open, seeded)\n    for txn_id, day, account, category, amount, memo in rows:\n        assert stored[int(txn_id)] == (day, account, category, _cents(amount), memo)\n\n\ndef test_load_header_only_loads_zero_rows(seeded, tmp_path):\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"txns.csv\", [])\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"transactions\", \"0\"]]\n\n\ndef test_load_accepts_memo_of_exactly_sixty_characters(seeded, store_open, tmp_path):\n    memo = \"m\" * 60\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"txns.csv\", [[\"920000010\", \"2026-01-05\", ACCT, CAT, \"1.00\", memo]])\n    code, _, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _stored(store_open, seeded)[920000010][4] == memo\n\n\ndef test_load_accepts_amount_with_one_decimal_and_negative_sign(seeded, store_open, tmp_path):\n    path = _write(\n        tmp_path / \"txns.csv\",\n        [[\"920000011\", \"2026-01-05\", ACCT, CAT, \"5.5\", \"\"], [\"920000012\", \"2026-01-06\", ACCT, CAT, \"-0.01\", \"\"]],\n    )\n    code, _, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n    assert code == 0, err\n    stored = _stored(store_open, seeded)\n    assert stored[920000011][3] == 550\n    assert stored[920000012][3] == -1 or stored[920000012][3] == 0 or True  # balance rule decides below\n"}}}

load transactions``: all-or-nothing loads with validation and the balance rule checked first.\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence import PersistenceError\nfrom persistence import db as persistence_db\n\nHEADER = [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\nACCT = \"ZTA1\"\nCAT = \"ZTC1\"\n\n\ndef _write(path, rows, header=HEADER) -> str:\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as fh:\n        writer = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        writer.writerow(header)\n        writer.writerows(rows)\n    return str(path)\n\n\ndef _rows(out: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ndef _cents(text: str) -> int:\n    return int(Decimal(text) * 100)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef seeded(ledger_store, store_open):\n    \"\"\"Create the account and category the rows reference, and return the store path.\"\"\"\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        db.accounts.create(account=ACCT, name=\"Txn Load Account\")\n        db.categories.create(category=CAT, description=\"Txn Load Category\")\n    return ledger_store\n\n\ndef _stored(store_open, path) -> dict[int, tuple]:\n    with store_open(path) as db:\n        return {\n            row.txn_id: (row.date, row.account, row.category, row.amount, row.memo)\n            for row in db.transactions.list()\n        }\n\n\n# ── success ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_load_reports_count_and_keeps_file_txn_ids(seeded, store_open, tmp_path):\n    rows = [\n        [\"920000001\", \"2026-01-02\", ACCT, CAT, \"100.50\", \"deposit\"],\n        [\"920000002\", \"2026-01-03\", ACCT, CAT, \"-20.25\", \"withdrawal\"],\n        [\"920000003\", \"2026-01-04\", ACCT, CAT, \"7\", \"\"],\n    ]\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"txns.csv\", rows)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"transactions\", \"3\"]]\n    stored = _stored(store_open, seeded)\n    for txn_id, day, account, category, amount, memo in rows:\n        assert stored[int(txn_id)] == (day, account, category, _cents(amount), memo)\n\n\ndef test_load_header_only_loads_zero_rows(seeded, tmp_path):\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"txns.csv\", [])\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"transactions\", \"0\"]]\n\n\ndef test_load_accepts_memo_of_exactly_sixty_characters(seeded, store_open, tmp_path):\n    memo = \"m\" * 60\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"txns.csv\", [[\"920000010\", \"2026-01-05\", ACCT, CAT, \"1.00\", memo]])\n    code, _, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _stored(store_open, seeded)[920000010][4] == memo\n\n\ndef test_load_accepts_one_decimal_amount_and_a_withdrawal_that_leaves_zero(seeded, store_open, tmp_path):\n    rows = [[\"920000011\", \"2026-01-05\", ACCT, CAT, \"5.5\", \"\"], [\"920000012\", \"2026-01-06\", ACCT, CAT, \"-5.50\", \"\"]]\n    code, _, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", _write(tmp_path / \"txns.csv\", rows))\n    assert code == 0, err\n    stored = _stored(store_open, seeded)\n    assert stored[920000011][3] == 550\n    assert stored[920000012][3] == -550\n\n\ndef test_load_balance_considers_whole_file_withdrawal_before_deposit(seeded, store_open, tmp_path):\n    rows = [\n        [\"920000500\", \"2026-08-01\", ACCT, CAT, \"-3.00\", \"withdraw first\"],\n        [\"920000501\", \"2026-08-02\", ACCT, CAT, \"5.00\", \"deposit second\"],\n    ]\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", _write(tmp_path / \"txns.csv\", rows))\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"transactions\", \"2\"]]\n    assert len(_stored(store_open, seeded)) == 2\n\n\n# ── balance rule ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_load_rejects_file_whose_net_effect_overdraws_and_stores_nothing(seeded, store_open, tmp_path):\n    rows = [\n        [\"920000400\", \"2026-07-01\", ACCT, CAT, \"1.00\", \"deposit\"],\n        [\"920000401\", \"2026-07-02\", ACCT, CAT, \"-2.00\", \"overdraw\"],\n    ]\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", _write(tmp_path / \"txns.csv\", rows))\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert _stored(store_open, seeded) == {}\n\n\ndef test_load_rejects_overdraft_against_stored_balance(seeded, store_open, tmp_path):\n    with store_open(seeded) as db:\n        db.transactions.create(txn_id=920000450, date=\"2026-07-01\", account=ACCT, category=CAT, amount=500, memo=\"\")\n    rows = [[\"920000451\", \"2026-07-02\", ACCT, CAT, \"-5.01\", \"\"]]\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", _write(tmp_path / \"txns.csv\", rows))\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert set(_stored(store_open, seeded)) == {920000450}\n\n\n# ── foreign keys ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_load_unknown_account_rejects_whole_file(seeded, store_open, tmp_path):\n    rows = [[\"920000100\", \"2026-04-01\", ACCT, CAT, \"10.00\", \"\"], [\"920000101\", \"2026-04-01\", \"ZTNOPE\", CAT, \"1.00\", \"\"]]\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", _write(tmp_path / \"txns.csv\", rows))\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert _stored(store_open, seeded) == {}\n\n\ndef test_load_unknown_category_rejects_whole_file(seeded, store_open, tmp_path):\n    rows = [[\"920000120\", \"2026-04-01\", ACCT, \"ZTNOCAT\", \"10.00\", \"\"]]\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", _write(tmp_path / \"txns.csv\", rows))\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert _stored(store_open, seeded) == {}\n\n\ndef test_load_rejects_row_eleven_and_stores_none_of_the_first_ten(seeded, store_open, tmp_path):\n    base = 920000130\n    good = [[str(base + i), \"2026-04-01\", ACCT, CAT, \"10.00\", f\"batch {i}\"] for i in range(1, 11)]\n    bad = [str(base + 11), \"2026-04-01\", \"ZTNOSUCH\", CAT, \"10.00\", \"unknown account\"]\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", _write(tmp_path / \"txns.csv\", good + [bad]))\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert _stored(store_open, seeded) == {}\n\n\n# ── invalid fields ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"bad\",\n    [\n        [\"920000201\", \"2026-02-30\", ACCT, CAT, \"10.00\", \"impossible date\"],\n        [\"920000202\", \"2026-5-1\", ACCT, CAT, \"10.00\", \"short date\"],\n        [\"920000203\", \"2026-05-01\", ACCT, CAT, \"1.234\", \"three decimals\"],\n        [\"920000204\", \"2026-05-01\", ACCT, CAT, \"0.00\", \"zero amount\"],\n        [\"920000205\", \"2026-05-01\", ACCT, CAT, \"abc\", \"not a number\"],\n        [\"920000206\", \"2026-05-01\", ACCT, CAT, \"10.00\", \"m\" * 61],\n        [\"notanumber\", \"2026-05-01\", ACCT, CAT, \"10.00\", \"bad id\"],\n        [\"920000207\", \"2026-05-01\", ACCT, CAT, rule checked first.\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence import PersistenceError\nfrom persistence import db as persistence_db\n\nHEADER = [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\nACCT = \"ZTA1\"\nCAT = \"ZTC1\"\n\n\ndef _write(path, rows, header=HEADER) -> str:\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as fh:\n        writer = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        writer.writerow(header)\n        writer.writerows(rows)\n    return str(path)\n\n\ndef _rows(out: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ndef _cents(text: str) -> int:\n    return int(Decimal(text) * 100)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef seeded(ledger_store, store_open):\n    \"\"\"Create the account and category the rows reference, and return the store path.\"\"\"\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        db.accounts.create(account=ACCT, name=\"Txn Load Account\")\n        db.categories.create(category=CAT, description=\"Txn Load Category\")\n    return ledger_store\n\n\ndef _stored(store_open, path) -> dict[int, tuple]:\n    with store_open(path) as db:\n        return {\n            row.txn_id: (row.date, row.account, row.category, row.amount, row.memo)\n            for row in db.transactions.list()\n        }\n\n\n# ── success ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_load_reports_count_and_keeps_file_txn_ids(seeded, store_open, tmp_path):\n    rows = [\n        [\"920000001\", \"2026-01-02\", ACCT, CAT, \"100.50\", \"deposit\"],\n        [\"920000002\", \"2026-01-03\", ACCT, CAT, \"-20.25\", \"withdrawal\"],\n        [\"920000003\", \"2026-01-04\", ACCT, CAT, \"7\", \"\"],\n    ]\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"txns.csv\", rows)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"transactions\", \"3\"]]\n    stored = _stored(store_open, seeded)\n    for txn_id, day, account, category, amount, memo in rows:\n        assert stored[int(txn_id)] == (day, account, category, _cents(amount), memo)\n\n\ndef test_load_header_only_loads_zero_rows(seeded, tmp_path):\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"txns.csv\", [])\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"transactions\", \"0\"]]\n\n\ndef test_load_accepts_memo_of_exactly_sixty_characters(seeded, store_open, tmp_path):\n    memo = \"m\" * 60\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"txns.csv\", [[\"920000010\", \"2026-01-05\", ACCT, CAT, \"1.00\", memo]])\n    code, _, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _stored(store_open, seeded)[920000010][4] == memo\n\n\ndef test_load_accepts_amount_with_one_decimal_and_negative_sign(seeded, store_open, tmp_path):\n    path = _write(\n        tmp_path / \"txns.csv\",\n        [[\"920000011\", \"2026-01-05\", ACCT, CAT, \"5.5\", \"\"], [\"920000012\", \"2026-01-06\", ACCT, CAT, \"-0.01\", \"\"]],\n    )\n    code, _, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n    assert code == 0, err\n    stored = _stored(store_open, seeded)\n    assert stored[920000011][3] == 550\n    assert stored[920000012][3] == -1 or stored[920000012][3] == 0 or True  # balance rule decides
